steps.name: Did this change touch any proof source?
steps.run:
# Non-PR events (push, schedule, dispatch) always verify.
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
  echo "proofs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0
fi
base="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"
head="${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
changed=$(git diff --name-only "$base" "$head" 2>/dev/null || true)
if printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -qE '^(lol/proofs/|2-protocols/avow/avow-lib/src/abi/.*\.idr$|1-formats/k9/spec/proofs/|2-protocols/k9-coordination/tools/validate/proofs/|3-practice/fork-governance/proofs/|\.github/workflows/echidna-verify\.yml$)'; then
  echo "proofs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "proofs=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Guard — proofs are evicted from this repo
steps.run:
# Same honesty guard idris2-avow got (see its Type-check step),
# placed BEFORE the toolchain install so the weekly cron stops
# spending minutes bootstrapping for a directory that does not
# exist. lol/proofs moved to the lol repository; if the corpus ever
# returns here, this job verifies again, unchanged (issue #748).
if [ ! -d lol/proofs ]; then
  echo "::notice title=Agda proofs::lol/proofs is absent here — proofs were evicted to the lol repository. Nothing to type-check; remaining steps skipped."
  echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Install Agda
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y agda agda-stdlib
agda --version

steps.name: Type-check proofs
steps.run:
set -eo pipefail
echo "=== Agda proofs under lol/proofs ==="
find lol/proofs/theories -name '*.agda' -print
cd lol/proofs
failed=""
for f in $(find theories -name '*.agda'); do
  echo "--- checking $f ---"
  if ! agda --safe "$f" 2>&1 | tee -a ../../agda-verify.log; then
    failed="$failed$f"$'\n'
  fi
done
if [ -n "$failed" ]; then
  echo "::warning::agda --safe FAILED to type-check the following proof(s) (advisory until the evicted lol/proofs corpus's re-entry criteria are set; see issue #748):"
  printf '%s' "$failed" | sed 's/^/  - /'
else
  echo "All Agda proofs type-checked cleanly."
fi

steps.name: Postulate audit
steps.run:
echo "=== Postulate usage in lol/proofs ==="
grep -rn "postulate" lol/proofs/theories/ || echo "No postulates found"

steps.name: Install Idris2 via pack
steps.run:
set -e
if command -v idris2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "idris2 already present: $(idris2 --version)"
  exit 0
fi
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y build-essential libgmp-dev chezscheme
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/stefan-hoeck/idris2-pack.git "$HOME/idris2-pack"
cd "$HOME/idris2-pack"
# pack's install.bash prompts for the scheme binary; feeding newlines
# makes the prompt take its detected default (chezscheme) instead of
# hitting EOF (which aborts the bootstrap and leaves pack uninstalled).
yes '' | bash install.bash || echo "::warning::pack install had warnings"
# pack installs its launcher into ~/.local/bin (newer layout) and/or
# ~/.pack/bin (older); add both so `pack` resolves on PATH.
echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
echo "$HOME/.pack/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.pack/bin:$PATH"
# `install-api` is not a pack subcommand; `install-app idris2`
# installs the idris2 executable into the pack bin dir so the
# subsequent `idris2 --check` resolves. The base library (Prelude,
# base, contrib) ships with idris2, so no .ipkg is needed for a
# standalone --check.
pack install-app idris2
idris2 --version

steps.name: Type-check AVOW proofs
steps.run:
export PATH="$HOME/.pack/bin:$PATH"
# The per-file `if [ -f ]` guard below was written to tolerate absent
# proofs, but the `cd` ahead of it was NOT guarded, so a missing
# directory killed the step before the guard could ever run. In this
# repo 2-protocols/avow/ holds only BINDING.adoc - the proofs live in the
# avow-protocol repository - so the cd always failed and this job was
# permanently red. It only became visible once the workflow began
# running on pull requests.
if [ ! -d 2-protocols/avow/avow-lib ]; then
  echo "::notice title=AVOW proofs::2-protocols/avow/avow-lib is not present here (this repo carries only the BINDING). Nothing to type-check."
  exit 0
fi
cd 2-protocols/avow/avow-lib
for f in src/abi/Consent.idr src/abi/Unsubscribe.idr src/abi/Types.idr; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    echo "--- checking $f ---"
    idris2 --check "$f" 2>&1 | tee -a ../../idris2-avow.log
  fi
done

steps.name: Escape-hatch audit (idris2 --check accepts holes, so they are refused here)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
bad=0
for entry in $PROOFS; do
  f="${entry%%:*}/${entry#*:}"
  [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "::error file=$f::proof file is missing"; bad=1; continue; }
  grep -q '^%default total' "$f" || { echo "::error file=$f::no %default total"; bad=1; }
  # Comments removed first: the doc comments name what is refused.
  if sed -E 's/--.*$//; s/\|\|\|.*$//' "$f" \
     | grep -nE '\b(believe_me|assert_total|assert_smaller|idris_crash|postulate|partial|covering)\b|\?[A-Za-z_]'; then
    echo "::error file=$f::hole, postulate, believe_me, assert_* or a non-total annotation (lines above)"
    bad=1
  fi
done
exit "$bad"

steps.name: Install Idris2 via pack
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.pack/bin:$PATH"
echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
echo "$HOME/.pack/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
if command -v idris2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "idris2 already present: $(idris2 --version)"
  exit 0
fi
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y build-essential libgmp-dev chezscheme
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/stefan-hoeck/idris2-pack.git "$HOME/idris2-pack"
cd "$HOME/idris2-pack"
# See idris2-avow: the newlines take install.bash's detected scheme.
# yes dies of SIGPIPE once install.bash stops reading; under pipefail
# that alone would fail the step, so only install.bash's status counts.
{ yes '' || true; } | bash install.bash
pack install-app idris2
idris2 --version

steps.name: Type-check (fail-closed)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
idris2 --version | tee idris2-standards.log
sha256sum "$(readlink -f "$(command -v idris2)")" | tee -a idris2-standards.log
for entry in $PROOFS; do
  dir="${entry%%:*}" file="${entry#*:}"
  echo "--- $dir/$file ---" | tee -a idris2-standards.log
  out=$(cd "$dir" && idris2 --check --total "$file" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tee -a idris2-standards.log; exit 1; }
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | tee -a idris2-standards.log
  # idris2 exits 0 on some errors: a missing Prelude did, measured
  # 2026-11-09. Any reported error fails the check.
  if printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '^Error'; then
    echo "::error file=$dir/$file::idris2 reported an error but exited 0"; exit 1
  fi
done

steps.name: Case table matches the ReportBack model
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cd 3-practice/fork-governance/proofs
idris2 ReportBack.idr --exec main > "$RUNNER_TEMP/report-back-cases.tsv"
if ! cmp -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/report-back-cases.tsv" report-back-cases.tsv; then
  echo "::error file=3-practice/fork-governance/proofs/report-back-cases.tsv::differs from what ReportBack.idr prints; regenerate it with: idris2 ReportBack.idr --exec main > report-back-cases.tsv"
  diff "$RUNNER_TEMP/report-back-cases.tsv" report-back-cases.tsv | head -20
  exit 1
fi
echo "report-back-cases.tsv: $(wc -l < report-back-cases.tsv) cases, as the model prints them" | tee -a "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/idris2-standards.log"

steps.name: Summarise
steps.run:
echo "## ECHIDNA Trust Summary" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| Target | Result |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "|---|---|" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| Agda lol/proofs | ${{ needs.agda-lol.result }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| Idris2 a2ml | _evicted — a2ml project officially retired 2026-09-17 |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| Idris2 avow | ${{ needs.idris2-avow.result }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| Idris2 this repository (K9 Hunt gate, coordination.k9 grammar) | ${{ needs.idris2-standards.result }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "See artefacts for verification logs." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
